messages.author: e302709dad51d37a
messages.subject: Summary Stats Question
parts:
Hi,

I have a question about how the utilization is calculated for each resource...

Is it total resource activity time/total simulation time * 100? Or is it done differently?

Is it possible to have access to the undelying code the simmer.plot package uses?

Thanks,
John

Great thanks a lot,

I am working on generating idle times and overall equipment effectiveness (oee) metrics for this particular simulation.

Although you can get these using some calculations with the get_mon* functions, those might be helpful in the future.

John
